literal_meaning: চোখে ধরা (চোখে আটকে যাওয়া বা চোখে পড়া)
figurative_meaning_en: To be affected by the evil eye or jinxed
example_sentences_in_bangla: বাচ্চাটির চোখে ধরা গেছে, তাই কাঁদছে।
নতুন গাড়িটা কেনার পর চোখে ধরা হয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: The child has been struck by the evil eye, that's why it's crying.
The new car got jinxed right after purchase.
history: The idiom draws from ancient beliefs in the evil eye (nazar) prevalent in Bengali folklore, often warded off with amulets or rituals.
note: Commonly used in contexts involving sudden misfortune attributed to envy.
